name: prisma
description: Model, migrate, and query databases with Prisma ORM and Prisma Postgres through Prisma's official MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Schema modeling, migrations, typed queries, and Prisma Postgres.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to Prisma's official local MCP server (built into the Prisma CLI, npx prisma mcp) for migration status, migrate dev/reset, Prisma Postgres account operations, and documentation search. Ships skills for schema.prisma modeling and relations, the migrations workflow, efficient typed queries with transactions and N+1 avoidance, Prisma Postgres setup, and troubleshooting drift, shadow databases, and connection pooling.
defaultPrompt: Review my schema.prisma and propose indexes and relation fixes
Create a migration that adds {model} with a relation to {other model}
My Prisma migration failed with drift detected, walk me through fixing it
